source.excerpt: 魏文侯以卜子夏、田子方为师，每过段干木之庐必式。四方贤士多归之。文侯与群臣饮酒，乐，而天雨，命驾将适野。左右曰：“今日饮酒乐，天又雨，君将安之？”文侯曰：“吾与虞人期猎，虽乐，岂可无一会期哉！”乃往，身自罢之。韩借师于魏以伐赵。文侯曰：“寡人与赵，兄弟也，不敢闻命。”赵借师于魏以伐韩，文侯应之亦然。二国皆怒而去。已而知文侯以讲于己也，皆朝于魏。魏由是始大于三晋，诸侯莫能与之争。使乐羊伐中山，克之，以封其子击。文侯问于群臣曰：“我何如主？”皆曰：“仁君。”任座曰：“君得中山，不以封君之弟而以封君之子，何谓仁君？”文侯怒，任座趋出。次问翟璜，对曰：“仁君也。”文侯曰：“何以知之？”对曰：“臣闻君仁则臣直。向者任座之言直，臣是以知之。”文侯悦，使翟璜召任座而反之，亲下堂迎之，以为上客。文侯与田子方饮，文侯曰：“钟声不比乎？左高。”田子方笑。文侯曰：“何笑？”子方曰：“臣闻之，君明乐官，不明乐音。今君审于音，臣恐其聋于官也。”文侯曰：“善。”子击出，遭田子方于道，下车伏谒。子方不为礼。子击怒，谓子方曰：“富贵者骄人乎？贫贱者骄人乎？”子方曰：“亦贫贱者骄人耳，富贵者安敢骄人？国君而骄人则失其国，大夫而骄人则失其家。失其国者未闻有以国待之者也，失其家者未闻有以家待之者也。夫士贫贱者，言不用，行不合，则纳履而去耳，安往而不得贫贱哉！”子击乃谢之。文侯谓李克曰：“先生尝有言曰：‘家贫思良妻，国乱思良相。’今所置非成则璜，二子何如？”对曰：“卑不谋尊，疏不谋戚。臣在阙门之外，不敢当命。”文侯曰：“先生临事勿让。”克曰：“君弗察故也。居视其所亲，富视其所与，达视其所举，穷视其所不为，贫视其所不取，五者足以定之矣，何待克哉！”文侯曰：“先生就舍，吾之相定矣。”李克出，见翟璜。翟璜曰：“今者闻君召先生而卜相，果谁为之？”克曰：“魏成。”翟璜忿然作色曰：“西河守吴起，臣所进也；君内以鄴为忧，臣进西门豹；君欲伐中山，臣进乐羊；中山已拔，无使守之，臣进先生；君之子无傅，臣进屈侯鲋。以耳目之所睹记，臣何负于魏成？”李克曰：“子之言克于子之君者，岂将比周以求大官哉？君问相于克，克之对如是。所以知君之必相魏成者，魏成食禄千钟，什九在外，什一在内，是以东得卜子夏、田子方、段干木。此三人者，君皆师之；子所进五人者，君皆臣之。子恶得与魏成比也！”翟璜逡巡再拜曰：“璜，鄙人也，失对，愿卒为弟子。”
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 酒宴正欢
panels.caption: 魏文侯与群臣饮酒，气氛正好。
panels.scene: Warm ancient banquet room with teal-robed Marquis Wen seated among a few courtiers, simple bronze cups.

panels.title: 外面下雨了
panels.caption: 雨落下来，魏文侯却吩咐备车，准备出门。
panels.scene: Marquis rises and gestures toward courtyard where rain falls and a wooden carriage waits.

panels.title: 何必这时走
panels.caption: 身边的人劝他：“酒喝得高兴，天又下雨，您还要去哪儿？”
panels.scene: Courtiers look puzzled and respectfully gesture toward sheltered banquet and rainy courtyard; marquis listens.

panels.title: 还有一个约定
panels.caption: 魏文侯说：“我与掌管山林的人约好打猎，怎么能不去见一面呢？”
panels.scene: Marquis explains calmly, one hand toward the distant countryside; retain rain beyond doorway.

panels.title: 冒雨赴约
panels.caption: 他还是冒雨到了郊外，亲自去见赴约的人。
panels.scene: Marquis wearing simple ancient rain cloak reaches rural meeting place with one attendant; forest keeper waits sheltered beside a tree, rain continues.

panels.title: 亲自说取消
panels.caption: 到了以后，魏文侯亲自取消了这次狩猎。雨天可以不打猎，约好的人却不能被忘记。
panels.scene: Marquis speaks respectfully face-to-face with coarse-robed forest keeper under shelter; no hunting action or animals injured, no invented royal gift.

adaptations: 不把赴约写成冒雨完成狩猎。
等待者的具体地点、神态与雨具为艺术表现，不补赏赐或其他后续。

checks: 逐格核对情节、人物与关键道具
直接参考用户选定的徙木立信：夸张造型、简练黑线、平涂色块
无嵌入正文，无虚构结果
imageReview.notes: 六格顺序清楚，最终赴约说明取消，无实际狩猎。 已完成本轮画风统一并复查。

Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.

Forest keeper: adult man in coarse brown robe and cloth cap, standing beneath a tree or shelter. Ancient wooden carriage, rain cloak, no modern umbrella. No hunt or animal killing occurs.

styleRefinement.instructions: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle ONLY IMAGE 1, the edit target. IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
